summary.name: Deepnote
summary.one_liner: Deepnote is a collaborative data workspace combining Python and SQL notebooks, apps, dashboards, pipelines, and models for data teams and AI agents.
use_cases: collaborative data analysis with a team
querying databases with SQL in notebooks
training and serving machine learning models
summary.what_it_does: Deepnote is a cloud workspace for exploring data with Python and SQL in notebooks, with collaboration features such as sharing by link or email invite and comments and version review. It offers interactive visualizations, data apps, dashboards, spreadsheet-style data tables, scheduled pipelines and jobs, and model training and serving. The page says it connects to existing data stack tools through 100+ integrations via API or MCP, including warehouses, databases, lakehouses, dbt and Spark/Snowpark. Notebooks can be scheduled, deployed as APIs, and run on GPUs, and the page describes security features such as RBAC, SSO, directory sync and custom deployments.
notable: Notebooks with Python and SQL plus interactive apps and dashboards in one workspace
100+ integrations to existing data tools via API or MCP
Open source under Apache 2.0 according to a quoted testimonial
Free Student plan with more powerful hardware than the standard free tier, per the awesome-ai-tools listing
caveats: Pricing tiers beyond the free Student plan are not detailed on the page
Platform availability is described as cloud-based; no desktop or mobile apps are named
